frozen_source_row.notes: Stage 6 NCAA-round review: Fordham institutional history explicitly identifies the Saint Francis game as an NCAA Play-In game.

decisions.relevant_evidence: Fordham institutional history establishes that the Patriot League lacked an automatic bid; Fordham lost the NCAA-administered Saint Francis play-in, then still awaited an NCAA at-large bid, did not receive one, and entered the NIT. The game is therefore a qualifier outside the national bracket rather than an NCAA Tournament appearance. This is a post-freeze NCAA non-appearance qualifier challenge only; Owner Gate 1 must explicitly approve clearing the controlled round and applying the durable qualifier marker.
decisions.notes: Exact frozen row and post-ingest canonical identity are bound. curated_game_type must remain NCAA_TOURNAMENT; only the controlled postseason round may be cleared and the durable non-appearance qualifier marker appended. H/A/N, venue/location, score/result, overtime, raw evidence, and unrelated source fields are unchanged.
